title: OpenSpec UI Agentic Harness — per-change override
description: Per-change override for openspec/changes/<id>/harness.json — deep-merged over the global openspec/agent-harness.json, key by key. Only set fields you want to override; everything else stays inherited.

autonomyLevel.description: semi-autonomous and autonomous are accepted and persisted but not yet functional — see openspec/changes/agentic-harness/design.md.

mode.description: Whoever is configured as the review stepAgent is the accountable party for relaxing this to agent-sufficient.

requireConfirmationBetweenSteps.description: false lets a semi-autonomous/autonomous chain run this change's stages with no pause between them.

agentId.description: Must match an AgentDescriptor.id from packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts — kept in sync by hand (a small, stable list).
